case.summary:
Analyst summary for case HHG-016:

This online card-not-present transaction triggered a high-risk score in the 9th decile and was evaluated under the `card_not_present_new_device` pattern due to activity originating from a first-seen device using the Edge browser. Although the specific device is part of a massive fraud ring involving thousands of cards and millions in transaction volume, its individual hub-cap signal was suppressed because the family degree exceeded the threshold. The risk assessment was further solidified when the customer explicitly contacted the bank to deny making the transaction. Similar historical cases tied to this pattern consistently point to confirmed fraudulent activity on unrecognized devices. Consequently, the policy engine has executed the decision to block the card and create a formal case to prevent further losses.
